metadata.short_desc: QQ group <-> New API site integration: binding, quota economy, group fun & admin tools.
metadata.desc: AstrBot plugin linking QQ groups to a New API website, with user binding, quota economy, group interaction, admin tools, and auto unbind + account cleanup on group leave. No .env required - configure directly!

api_settings.description: New API website config (leave empty to fall back to .env)

api_base_url.description: New API website base URL (no trailing /); empty uses .env

api_access_token.description: Token generated in the New API dashboard; empty uses .env

api_admin_user_id.description: User ID used for admin operations; empty uses .env

database_settings.description: Database (MySQL) (leave empty to fall back to .env)

sqlite_settings.description: SQLite mode (⚠️ SQLite and MySQL are two separate datasets; switching does not migrate data, you must re-bind)

use_sqlite_mode.description: When enabled, bindings and heist logs are stored in a single SQLite file instead of MySQL (the MySQL config above is ignored)

min_qq_level.description: Minimum QQ level allowed to bind

quota_display_ratio.description: Quota display exchange rate (raw quota / this value)

forbidden_website_ids.description: Blacklisted website IDs (only blocks new bindings, existing bindings unaffected)

forbidden_user_ids.description: Blacklisted QQ numbers (only blocks new bindings, existing bindings unaffected)

diminish_enabled.description: Enable diminishing reward (the more balance, the lower the max reward per tier; the minimum stays unchanged)

diminish_threshold.description: Diminishing threshold (display quota); rewards start halving per tier beyond this

first_check_in_bonus_enabled.description: Whether to grant a first-check-in bonus

first_check_in_bonus_display_quota.description: Extra display quota for the first check-in

revert_group_on_leave.description: User group restored after leaving the group

enabled.description: Whether the heist feature is enabled

max_attempts_per_day.description: Max active heists per user per day

max_defenses_per_day.description: Max times a user can be successfully robbed per day

critical_chance.description: Probability of a critical (double) hit (0.0 to 1.0)

failure_chance.description: Probability of failure and penalty (0.0 to 1.0)

failure_penalty.description: [Display quota] paid to the victim on failure

attempts_exceeded_template.description: Message when the robber's attempts are used up

defenses_exceeded_template.description: Message when the victim's defenses are used up. Variables: {victim_id}

victim_not_found_template.description: Message when the target is not found. Variables: {victim_identifier}

cannot_rob_self_template.description: Message when trying to rob yourself

robber_not_bound_template.description: Message when the robber is not bound

enabled.description: Whether the leaderboard feature is enabled

top_n.description: Number of ranks shown on the leaderboard

consumption_leaderboard_settings.description: [Leaderboard] Site-wide 24h consumption board (requires New API 'record consume logs')

enabled.description: Whether the consumption leaderboard is enabled (depends on New API consume logs; empty if logging is off)

top_n.description: Number of ranks shown on the board

enable_bind_success_pm.description: Whether to send a PM after binding succeeds
